selection:

        - '*vssadmin delete shadows*'

versions.subject: Rule: added wmic SHADOWCOPY DELETE

selection:
    CommandLine:
        - '*vssadmin delete shadows*'
        - '*wmic SHADOWCOPY DELETE*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*vssadmin delete shadows*", "*wmic SHADOWCOPY DELETE*")
